verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main screen (Today) — expense entry keypad / category row
verdicts_or_reports.element: Category field confirm (check) button in the category row above the number pad
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Confirming a custom category in the category field once should apply the category and save the entered expense once (one €0.10 Test2 entry).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: One tap on the check button created two identical expenses: two "Test2" entries of €0.1 at 07:05 AM, and Today's Total became €0.7 (€0.5 existing + €0.1 + €0.1) instead of €0.6. The same happened earlier with a custom "Gifts" category (two €0.3 entries from one tap).
steps: Enter an amount on the main screen keypad (e.g., tap . then 1 to get €0.1).
Tap the Category field in the chip row above the number pad.
Type a custom category name (e.g., Test2) in the focused field.
Tap the green check button at the right end of the category field once.
Drag the bottom sheet down to open Today's expense list and observe.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main screen (Today) — amount display + number pad
verdicts_or_reports.element: Amount field above the number pad
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After deleting the digits of a decimal amount until the field reads $0, the pending decimal separator should either stay visible (e.g. $0.) or be cleared, so that entering 5 afterwards starts from zero and shows $5.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Enter 0.5, tap the X (delete) key once: the field shows "$0", but the decimal separator is still active. Tapping 5 then produces "$0.5" instead of "$5". Further deletions are needed before whole-dollar entry works, and the display never indicates the pending decimal separator.
steps: On the main screen keypad tap . then 5 to enter $0.5.
Tap the yellow X (delete) key once; the amount field shows $0.
The field becomes $0.5 again (fractional entry still active) instead of $5.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Amount display (EditText "$0") above the number pad
verdicts_or_reports.expected: When the amount display reads exactly "$0" (no decimal separator shown), typing 5 should give $5. If the app instead keeps fractional entry active, the display should show the pending separator, e.g. "$0.".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Exact sequence on this build: tap 0, tap ., tap 5 → amount display "$0.5". Tap the yellow X once → amount display changes to "$0" (toolbar remaining goes back to "$1.9"). Now tap 5 → the amount display becomes "$0.5" again and the toolbar remaining drops to "$1.4", i.e. the invisible decimal separator is still active while the field shows plain "$0".
steps: With an empty amount, tap 0, then the decimal key '.', then 5. The amount field shows $0.5.
Tap the yellow X (delete) key exactly once. The amount field now shows $0 and the budget pill shows $1.9.
Tap 5 on the number pad. The field shows $0.5 (not $5) and the budget pill shows $1.4.
Repeatable: do the same after typing 0.12 and deleting back to $0; the next digit is still treated as a decimal.
